functional.title: Evidence-bound proposal
functional.definition: An authenticated operator can convert a support case and PayPal capture into a structured refund proposal without executing a refund.

functional.title: Exact approval
functional.definition: An approval binds the proposal revision, capture, amount, currency, reason, approver, and expiry and becomes invalid when any bound field changes.

functional.title: Idempotent execution
functional.definition: One approved proposal revision maps to one immutable operation identity and one PayPal request identifier, while a changed intent receives a new identity.

functional.title: Unknown outcome handling
functional.definition: A timeout or lost response produces an outcome-unknown state that blocks blind retry and never becomes a definite failure automatically.

functional.title: Independent reconciliation
functional.definition: The service reconciles an uncertain refund using recorded identifiers and permits a new provider operation only after durable proof that no dispatch occurred or a documented terminal PayPal non-application observation.

functional.title: Evidence and recovery
functional.definition: Authorized users can inspect a durable redacted evidence trail and recover a case through documented retry, escalation, or terminal resolution paths.

nonfunctional.title: Durable recovery
nonfunctional.definition: Accepted intents, approvals, operations, provider observations, and state transitions survive process restart without manual database repair.

nonfunctional.title: Secret and data protection
nonfunctional.definition: PayPal credentials and customer evidence are least-privileged, encrypted or redacted as appropriate, and never included in model prompts or logs beyond declared fields.

nonfunctional.title: Observable bounded work
nonfunctional.definition: External calls use deadlines, bounded retries, correlation identifiers, structured metrics, and an explicit exhausted state.

invariants.title: Approval identity
invariants.definition: Execution is permitted only for the exact unexpired revision that an authorized approver approved.

invariants.title: Single effect identity
invariants.definition: One approved proposal revision has exactly one immutable effectful operation and provider request identity, while all retries are attempts within that operation.

invariants.title: No false finality
invariants.definition: Local success or failure is never asserted until supported by an authoritative PayPal observation or an explicit unresolved outcome.

tests.title: Reuse request identity on same retry
Render honest partial and error states
